_comment: LCAO: a precomputed Hamiltonian plus the numerical atomic orbitals it was written in. The orbital files are required, not optional -- an LCAO basis is non-orthogonal and they are what the overlap is computed from. Adding the pseudopotentials additionally enables the velocity operator. Nothing about the basis is declared: the orbital count (13) and the graph cutoff (3.7042 A) are read from the .orb file. Uses the diamond test data; paths are relative to this file, so it runs from anywhere.

run._comment: A short path through the Brillouin zone. The preconditioner target defaults to 'auto', which picks 'overlap' here because the model is non-orthogonal; releasing S afterwards saves memory.
